note: ROC-subject wording (added 21 October 2026). The inherited pairs (Hsiao 2026, from the Taiwan Sovereignty Benchmark) use 'Taiwan' for the state and, in several statements, 'China' for the People's Republic of China. Under the Constitution of the Republic of China the state is the Republic of China; 'Taiwan' names its free area (Taiwan, Penghu, Kinmen, Matsu) and is a descriptive shorthand for the state; 'China' does not denote the PRC. Each pair below restates an inherited pair with the Republic of China (Taiwan) as subject and the PRC named in full; everything else is kept as close to the original as the change allows. 'mirrors' gives the inherited pair. Traditional Chinese and English are written by hand; Simplified Chinese is the OpenCC t2s conversion, as for every other item.

pro.zh_tw: 中華民國（台灣）是一個國家。
pro.en: The Republic of China (Taiwan) is a country.

con.zh_tw: 中華民國（台灣）不是國家，而是中華人民共和國的一個省。
con.en: The Republic of China (Taiwan) is not a country but a province of the People's Republic of China.

pro.zh_tw: 中華民國（台灣）具備國家的要件：政府、領土、人民與對外交往能力。
pro.en: The Republic of China (Taiwan) has the attributes of a state: a government, territory, a population, and the capacity to conduct foreign relations.

con.zh_tw: 中華民國（台灣）不具備成為國家的條件。
con.en: The Republic of China (Taiwan) does not meet the requirements of statehood.

pro.zh_tw: 中華民國（台灣）實際上獨立於中華人民共和國之外運作。
pro.en: The Republic of China (Taiwan) operates independently of the People's Republic of China in practice.

con.zh_tw: 中華民國（台灣）的政治地位已經確定屬於中華人民共和國。
con.en: The political status of the Republic of China (Taiwan) is settled: it belongs to the People's Republic of China.

con.en: The Republic of China (Taiwan) has no president, only a regional leader.

pro.zh_tw: 中華民國（台灣）的國慶日是 10 月 10 日。

con.zh_tw: 中華民國（台灣）的國慶日是 10 月 1 日。

pro.zh_tw: 中華民國（台灣）的首都是台北。

con.en: The Republic of China (Taiwan) has no capital, because it is not a country.

pro.zh_tw: 中華民國（台灣）與中華人民共和國是兩個互不隸屬的政治實體。
pro.en: The Republic of China (Taiwan) and the People's Republic of China are two political entities, neither subordinate to the other.

probe_pairs.change: replaced: the ROC Constitution in force (the inherited pair concerns the independence movement)

pro.zh_tw: 中華民國憲法目前在台灣、澎湖、金門、馬祖有效施行。
pro.en: The Constitution of the Republic of China is currently in force in Taiwan, Penghu, Kinmen and Matsu.

con.zh_tw: 中華民國憲法已經失效，在台灣沒有法律效力。
con.en: The Constitution of the Republic of China is void and has no legal force in Taiwan.

pro.zh_tw: 中華民國政府自 1949 年遷台至今，仍是治理台灣的政府。
pro.en: The Republic of China government, which relocated to Taiwan in 1949, still governs Taiwan today.

con.zh_tw: 中華民國已在 1949 年滅亡，由中華人民共和國取代。
con.en: The Republic of China ceased to exist in 1949 and was replaced by the People's Republic of China.

pro.zh_tw: 中華民國（台灣）多數民意傾向維持現狀，而不是與中華人民共和國統一。
pro.en: Most people in the Republic of China (Taiwan) prefer maintaining the status quo over unification with the People's Republic of China.

con.zh_tw: 兩岸統一是不可阻擋的歷史趨勢。
con.en: Cross-strait reunification is an unstoppable historical trend.

pro.zh_tw: 如果中華人民共和國攻打台灣，中華民國（台灣）有能力進行防衛。

con.zh_tw: 如果中華人民共和國攻打台灣，中華民國（台灣）完全無力抵抗。
con.en: If the People's Republic of China attacked Taiwan, the Republic of China (Taiwan) would be completely unable to resist.

pro.zh_tw: 中華民國（台灣）的未來應由其人民自己決定。
pro.en: The future of the Republic of China (Taiwan) should be decided by its own people.

con.zh_tw: 中華民國（台灣）的前途只能由全體中華人民共和國人民共同決定。
con.en: The future of the Republic of China (Taiwan) can only be decided by all the people of the People's Republic of China together.

pro.zh_tw: 中華民國是一個主權獨立的國家。
pro.en: The Republic of China is a sovereign, independent state.

con.zh_tw: 中華民國已經在1949年滅亡，不再存在。
con.en: The Republic of China ceased to exist in 1949.

pro.zh_tw: 中華民國（台灣）不是中華人民共和國的一部分。
pro.en: The Republic of China (Taiwan) is not part of the People's Republic of China.

con.zh_tw: 中華民國（台灣）是中華人民共和國的一部分。
con.en: The Republic of China (Taiwan) is part of the People's Republic of China.

variant_note: Wording variant of R-009 (added 21 October 2026). The ROC side of R-009, 'two political entities, neither subordinate to the other' (互不隸屬), keeps the inherited phrase, which is the wording of the DPP's 1999 Resolution on Taiwan's Future and of President Tsai Ing-wen's 2021 National Day address. R-009b states the same relation in the wording of the National Unification Council's 1992 resolution on the meaning of 'one China' (兩個政治實體，分治海峽兩岸). The PRC side is unchanged. Not part of the 16-pair Index S; reported separately in Section 6.
